title: One decide-outcome fold: every Decisions door answers a code, one handoff rule
deviations_from_card: Commit order: catalog key and doc committed first and alone under the shared-surface lock (ec8bb1f2f, f88e69751), then fold+tests, then route+hook+guard. foldBatchDecide returns arrays (not Sets) so the 'JSON.stringify has no English' case is meaningful; added a 7th fold case: a target the server never reported is a failure, not a silent success. The route case needed a hybrid interviewPlan (setDecisionConfig) since the unit DB default does not route. Per-id batch codes with no catalog entry add nothing to the band (the 'N couldn't be decided' count stands) rather than a misleading 'nothing was decided' fallback. act() split into postDecide (fetch+fold, never throws) + applyHandoffs (shared with batch) + act (apply) so slot B can wrap act() unchanged. useAddToPipeline.ts's contradictory 'verbatim reason' doc comment corrected per critic floor note.
notes: tsc exit 0 on my paths: the whole-tree run was red only on foreign paths (untracked kpi-sim/runs/**, sibling in-flight app/_lib/devcase-authenticity.test.ts and app/_lib/repo-snapshot.ts). design:check not applicable (no classNames touched). Full test:unit 9988/9988 green. test:perf red on 24 route import-graph overages (+2 modules / ~+28KB each on devcase/agents/analyze/intake/jds... routes) - none reach app/api/pipeline/batch or the Decisions client; they track sibling UNCOMMITTED edits to app/_lib/devcase-run.ts / repo-snapshot.ts / github/client.ts. My route change adds no import. DecisionsBatchBar.tsx still renders bulkResult.reason, which is now always localized.
